props.selectStrategy:
Defines the strategy of selecting items in the list.
- **single:** Only one item can be selected at a time.
- **page:** 'Select all' button will select only items on the current page.
- **filtered:** 'Select all' button will select only items matching the current search, across all pages.
- **all:** 'Select all' button will select all items in the list.
props.showSelect: Shows the column with checkboxes for selecting items in the list.
